content_sections.heading: UIPS Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. UIPS/26/3589 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download UIPS notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.Pharm. and M.Pharm. with a minimum of 55% marks (50% in case of SC/ST/PH candidates); M.Pharm. should be in a relevant specialization; Candidates having qualified GPAT/GATE/Ph.D. Entrance Test or any National Entrance Test conducted by a Central Government Department will be preferred Experience: Preference to candidates having relevant research experience, publications and knowledge of pharmaceutical formulation development Other conditions: No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. Desirable: Qualified GPAT/GATE/Ph.D. Entrance Test or any National Entrance Test conducted by a Central Government Department Good academic records Relevant research experience and publications

content_sections.heading: How Will UIPS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of eligible candidates Interview in the office of Chairperson, UIPS, Panjab University, Chandigarh Evaluation on the basis of marks obtained in B.Pharm. and M.Pharm. Shortlisted candidates must bring relevant documents to support the application at the interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Curriculum Vitae Copies of academic certificates Mark sheets Other relevant documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UIPS Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Prepare the application with Curriculum Vitae, copies of academic certificates, mark sheets and other relevant documents. Submit it to the office of Dr. Vandita Kakkar, Associate Professor of Pharmaceutics, UIPS, Panjab University, Chandigarh, or by email to [email protected] . Submit latest by 18-11-2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for UIPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in UIPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for UIPS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Office of Dr. Vandita Kakkar, Associate Professor of Pharmaceutics, University Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Panjab University, Chandigarh, by submission at the office of the undersigned or by email, to reach by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 10,000 per month for two years only.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.Pharm. and M.Pharm. with a minimum of 55% marks (50% in case of SC/ST/PH candidates); M.Pharm. should be in a relevant specialization. GPAT/GATE/Ph.D. Entrance Test or any National Entrance Test conducted by a Central Government Department preferred.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of eligible candidates. Interview in the office of Chairperson, UIPS, Panjab University, Chandigarh. Evaluation on the basis of marks obtained in B.Pharm. and M.Pharm. Shortlisted candidates must bring relevant documents to support the application at the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Fellowship for a period of two years only. Under Industry Academie Research Grant sponsored by Impa Laboratories. Work under the supervision of Dr. Vandita Kakkar in Pharmaceutical Formulation Development.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: University Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Panjab University, Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Curriculum Vitae; Copies of academic certificates; Mark sheets; Other relevant documents.
